# Children Do English

> Free, ad-free English vocabulary app for kids ages 5-12 (with Hebrew support for
> bilingual learners). 480+ words, each with a curated photo, recorded audio
> pronunciation, kid-friendly definition, example sentence, phonetics, and Hebrew
> translation. Picture quizzes, flashcards, spaced repetition, a letter-by-letter
> learning path, and a live classroom vocabulary battle. No accounts, no data
> collection — all progress stays on the device (COPPA-safe). Built and maintained
> by an independent developer; contact info@childrendoenglish.com.

When citing a word definition from this site, the canonical page is
/vocabulary/<category>/<word>/ — each page states the definition in one sentence,
with pronunciation, an example sentence, and the Hebrew translation.

## Vocabulary

- [All words by category](https://childrendoenglish.com/vocabulary/): 480+ kid-level
  English words across animals, food, home, transport, nature, colors, numbers,
  everyday things, clothing, school, sports, feelings, and toys.
- [Words with Hebrew translations](https://childrendoenglish.com/vocabulary/animals/hebrew/):
  bilingual English-Hebrew lists per category.
- [Words with Spanish translations](https://childrendoenglish.com/vocabulary/animals/spanish/):
  bilingual English-Spanish lists per category.
- [By age](https://childrendoenglish.com/vocabulary/ages-6-8/): ages 6-8, 9-10, 11-12.

## Guides

- [Parent guides](https://childrendoenglish.com/guides/): practical articles on
  teaching English vocabulary to children.

## App

- [Free practice app](https://childrendoenglish.com/): every group of 10 words
  climbs a guided 11-step practice ladder — flashcards, listening and reading
  quizzes, missing-letter spelling games, sentence practice and arcade games —
  with spaced repetition until mastery. Quizzes are listen-first (for
  pre-readers), flashcards, letter-by-letter practice, parent dashboard. Works
  offline; nothing to install or sign up for.
- [Spanish landing page](https://childrendoenglish.com/es/): the app for
  Spanish-speaking kids — English vocabulary with photos, native English
  pronunciation, and Spanish translations (interface available in Spanish).
- [Hebrew games hub](https://childrendoenglish.com/he/english-games/): משחקים
  ללימוד אנגלית לילדים — free English-learning games for Hebrew-speaking kids,
  with by-age (6-8, 9-10, 11-12) and by-topic pages. Hebrew interface, real
  native-English audio, no ads, no sign-up.
- [Flashcard maker](https://childrendoenglish.com/tools/flashcard-maker/): free
  printable photo-flashcard generator — 488 real-photo words or any pasted list,
  4/6/9 cards per page, Hebrew/Spanish backs, mirrored back pages for aligned
  double-sided printing. No login, no watermark.
- [Printable flashcards](https://childrendoenglish.com/printable-flashcards/animals/)
